neighbours.label: Things spread here and there through a whole: 'scattered', 'sprinkled with', 'most of', 'in a number of spots', notes through a text; whole-thing statements stay low.
fire: The essay is peppered with quotations from a number of ancient authors.
Spelling mistakes are dotted here and there across the manual.
He pencilled comments in the margins of most of the chapters.
Small farms lie scattered over a large part of the valley.
The film is studded with jokes in a number of its scenes.
Patches of snow remained here and there along the northern slope.
Wildflowers are sprinkled across most of the hillside in spring.
Clues are hidden in various spots throughout the novel.
quiet: The essay is about the lives of two ancient authors.
Spelling mistakes are a serious problem in the manual.
He bought a new pencil and read the first chapter.
Small farms grow wheat and barley in the valley.
The film is a comedy about a family in Ohio.
Heavy snow covered the entire northern slope this winter.
Wildflowers bloom on the hillside in the spring.
The novel is a mystery set in Vienna.

predictions: 6/8 fire, 0-1 near miss. This pattern replaced a token list (annotated, of, spots, every, mostly) and is tested on new phrases.
notes: Probes: 'sprinkled with' 1.12, 'annotated' 0.84, 'in a number of spots' 0.73, 'here and there' 0.53, 'most of' 0.22-0.51, 'every step' 0.58; plain versions 0.02-0.11. ' poems' 0.11-0.24 is a baseline to watch. 'zeroes of machine code' 0.53 doesn't fit this pattern.
